title: WorkBench Revisited: Workplace Agents Two Years On

live_model.evidence: "We evaluate 24 models released between March 2023 and June 2026: the GPT line from GPT-3.5-turbo through GPT-5.5..."; Table 1 row 'GPT-4-turbo': 61.3% completion, 22.3% side effects, $0.307/task.

prompt.location: Sec 2.1 (Agent harness): native tool-calling loop, task + all 26 tools + up to 20 steps, temperature 0 where permitted; corrections to scoring/ground-truth/prompts documented in an appendix
prompt.note: Harness and protocol are described in detail; the underlying WorkBench task set is the original public benchmark (revised here), not reprinted verbatim in the main text.

claim.location: Table 1, row 'GPT-4-turbo': completion 61.3%, side effects 22.3%, cost/task $0.307; "Completion and side effects are over all 690 tasks"

data.source: WorkBench benchmark (690 tasks, 26 tools), original 2024 release revised/corrected in this paper's appendix

notes: Clean, directly comparable agentic benchmark; GPT-4-turbo is 1 of 24 models run under an identical native-tool-calling harness. Cost per task ($0.307) x 690 tasks is roughly $212 for a single pass, well into the high tier, though the paper's own cost figure is an upper bound (no prompt caching).
